q1.description: Comedies written by Oscar Wilde — 2-hop, GD optimal, low cardinality
q1.source: Wikipedia 'Oscar Wilde bibliography' — plays section, genre classification
q1.nl_prompt_naive: What comedies did Oscar Wilde write?
q1.nl_prompt_precise: List every single play written by Oscar Wilde that belongs to the comedy genre. Include all of them, even lesser-known ones.
q1.sparql_prompt: SELECT ?b WHERE { Oscar_Wilde wrote ?b . ?b hasGenre comedy . }

q2.description: UN member countries with Portuguese as official language — 2-hop, DG optimal, medium cardinality
q2.source: Wikipedia 'Portuguese language' (official status section) + UN member state list
q2.nl_prompt_naive: Which countries are UN members and have Portuguese as an official language?
q2.nl_prompt_precise: List every single country that is both a member of the United Nations and recognises Portuguese as an official language. Be exhaustive.
q2.sparql_prompt: SELECT ?b WHERE { United_Nations hasMember ?b . ?b hasOfficialLanguage Portuguese . }

q3.description: Shakespeare plays primarily set in Italian cities — 3-hop, medium cardinality
q3.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica 'Shakespeare works' + Wikipedia individual play articles
q3.nl_prompt_naive: Which Shakespeare plays are set in Italian cities?
q3.nl_prompt_precise: List every single play written by William Shakespeare that is set in a city or location in Italy. Include every single one.
q3.sparql_prompt: SELECT ?b1 WHERE { William_Shakespeare wrote ?b1 . ?b1 isSetIn ?b2 . ?b2 isLocatedIn Italy . }

q4.description: African member countries of the Commonwealth of Nations — 3-hop, high cardinality
q4.source: Wikipedia 'Member states of the Commonwealth of Nations' (2024, includes Gabon and Togo who joined 2022)
q4.nl_prompt_naive: Which African countries are members of the Commonwealth of Nations?
q4.nl_prompt_precise: List every single country in Africa that is a full member of the Commonwealth of Nations. Include all of them, including those that joined recently.
q4.sparql_prompt: SELECT ?b1 WHERE { Commonwealth_of_Nations hasMember ?b1 . ?b1 isLocatedOn continent Africa . ?b1 hasCapital ?b2 . ?b2 isLocatedOn continent Africa . }

q5.description: Nobel Prize in Literature laureates born in Asia — 4-hop, medium cardinality
q5.nl_prompt_naive: Which Nobel Prize in Literature winners were born in Asia?
q5.nl_prompt_precise: List every single Nobel Prize in Literature laureate who was born in a country in Asia. Include every single one, from the first awarded to the most recent.

q7.description: Countries that won the FIFA World Cup — 2-hop T4a pure
q7.nl_prompt_naive: Which countries have won the FIFA World Cup?
q7.nl_prompt_precise: List every single country that has won the FIFA World Cup at least once. Be exhaustive.
